propagation_models.description: 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa median outdoor urban path loss with deterministic height-aware footprint LOS/NLOS classification
propagation_models.model_family: 3GPP UMa outdoor urban median path loss
propagation_models.formula: PL_LOS = PL1/PL2 with dBP; PL_NLOS = max(PL_LOS, PL') using Table 7.4.1-1
limitations: no shadow fading, Fresnel clearance, diffraction, or reflection
unknown building heights use conservative 2D NLOS

propagation_models.description: Legacy FSPL with frequency-dependent footprint wall-event loss
propagation_models.model_family: free-space path loss plus footprint wall events
propagation_models.formula: P_rx = P_tx(conducted) + G_tx,absolute - A_tx,pattern - L_propagation - L_building - L_system - L_polarization + G_rx + calibration
limitations: not an empirical urban path-loss model

propagation_models.description: Research-only sub-THz planning profile using the legacy conservative attenuation envelope
propagation_models.formula: P_rx = P_tx(conducted) + G_tx,absolute - A_tx,pattern - L_propagation - L_building - L_system - L_polarization + G_rx + calibration
limitations: uses conservative planning attenuation rather than a validated 140 GHz channel model

rf_contract.model_description: 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa median outdoor urban path loss with deterministic height-aware footprint LOS/NLOS classification
rf_contract.reference: 3GPP TR 38.901 V19.4.0, Table 7.4.1-1 UMa path loss
rf_contract.applicability: 0.5 < f_c < 100 GHz, 10 m <= d_2D <= 5000 m, known Tx/Rx heights in the deterministic UMa envelope, outdoor-to-outdoor endpoint, and footprint LOS/NLOS classification
rf_contract.fallback_policy: if the requested model is outside its explicit frequency, distance, endpoint, building-data, or LOS/NLOS scope, evaluate the legacy_fspl_walls model and report the reason
rf_contract.los_classification_rule: footprint-height-los-v1: no footprint is LOS; known-height footprints block only when the flat-ground geometric centerline reaches the roof; cleared known roofs are LOS; unknown-height intersections use conservative NLOS; indoor endpoints and missing footprint data are not urban-applicable
rf_contract.building_height_note: explicit OSM height is observed_tag; building:levels is derived_from_levels using 3 m per level; generic 9 m fallback is never roof evidence and unknown intersections remain conservative NLOS
rf_contract.propagation_dimensions: height-aware 2D footprint centerline visibility with flat-ground relative heights and 3D distance in the 3GPP UMa median path-loss equation
rf_contract.wall_model: none in the urban formula; footprint boundaries classify outdoor LOS/NLOS and are not converted into legacy wall dB
rf_contract.link_budget_equation: P_rx = P_tx(conducted) + G_tx,absolute - A_tx,pattern - PL_3GPP_UMa(LOS|NLOS) - L_system - L_polarization + G_rx + calibration
rf_contract.tx_power_semantics: tx_power_dbm is conducted transmitter output power before the configured absolute TX antenna gain
rf_contract.tx_gain_semantics: antenna_gain_dbi is the absolute TX boresight gain; tx_antenna_gain_dbi is its preferred input alias
rf_contract.rx_gain_semantics: rx_antenna_gain_dbi is an explicit receive-antenna gain applied after propagation; default 0 dBi
rf_contract.polarization_semantics: polarization_loss_db is an explicit deterministic link loss; default 0 dB; no orientation/vector mismatch model is implied
rf_contract.system_loss_semantics: system_loss_db is an explicit non-propagation loss applied after directional TX EIRP; default 0 dB
rf_contract.antenna_pattern_description: Compatibility ideal sector: zero relative pattern attenuation inside the configured hard beam; flat vertical cut
propagation_terms: 3GPP UMa PL1/PL2 breakpoint LOS path loss
3GPP UMa NLOS max(LOS, PL') path loss
rf_contract.receiver_sensitivity_scope: effective per-cell receiver threshold; mode and resolved terms are in receiver_threshold and rf_profile
rf_contract.receiver_sensitivity_equation: manual: sensitivity = configured receiver_sensitivity_dbm; derived: Nfloor = -174 dBm/Hz + 10log10(receiver_noise_bandwidth_hz) + receiver_noise_figure_db; sensitivity = Nfloor + receiver_required_snr_db + receiver_margin_db
rf_contract.receiver_noise_semantics: receiver sensitivity is noise-limited and excludes network interference; interference remains a separate RSRP/SINR/RSRQ analysis
rf_contract.building_service_rule: building is served when modeled received power is strictly greater than the building-service threshold
rf_contract.surface_nodata_definition: NoData means radius/beam geometry exclusion; below-sensitivity numeric values remain valid
rf_contract.interference_serviceability_rule: serviceable when RSRP, SINR, and RSRQ each meet their interference-planning thresholds
rf_contract.calibration_definition: global calibration offset; positive dB raises predicted received power
